safety._doc: Danger code word (safety/DangerAlert). Numbers are tried in order; Android never lets an app place a call to an emergency number such as 112 by itself, so the first number the app can dial alone is the police toll-free line 191, and the dial pad is opened on 112 if the call cannot start. Re-verify the numbers before release.

sos._doc: Manual SOS: a whole-utterance call for help, or volume-up held for holdMs. Same cancel window as the code word; works without the code word set up.
